card.name: Linking words inside lists of items
card.fires_on: Commas, 'or', 'and' and short prepositions that join items in a list or phrase, especially a list of drug names in a hypersensitivity statement. The next word is another item or a component.

modes.label: Drug lists in hypersensitivity
modes.description: A comma or 'or' after a drug name in a contraindication list, before another drug or 'any component'.
